scope: Independent static visual acceptance of repaired hand structure and boundary continuity; not deployment authorization or continuous-playback certification.
method: Direct view_image inspection of original-resolution hand-continuity-2x-black.png and hand-continuity-2x-white.png, plus 17 native 480px mapped frames.

evidence.observation: The previously unprotected anchor hands now retain readable open-hand silhouettes. Deep alpha notches that ate finger shapes in V5 are no longer evident at native size. Small contour softness remains but does not constitute severe structural loss.

Both sides of each inspected boundary now have intact open palms. The former complete-hand to eroded-hand switch is removed. Minor line-weight, palm crease and orientation differences remain, but no obvious new fist/open-hand snap or wrist separation is visible in the adjacent-frame inspection.

The broad pale sticker outline seen in V5 is substantially reduced. At native full-character size it no longer forms a conspicuous uniform band around the repaired hand. Fine light antialiasing, occasional bright pixels and small edge softness remain visible on dark backgrounds and at 2x; these are nonblocking residuals under this review's criterion.
Inspected native frames retain the same 2D character, body proportions, sleeves and face presentation. No severe new body deformation or 2D-to-3D material shift was observed.

nonBlockingNotes: F12-F14 and F20 have slightly different hand contour and crease treatment from the simpler donor-style hands; this is visible mainly in enlarged comparison.
Fine bright specks and residual edge softness are not claimed to be eliminated. Further global erosion is not recommended because it previously damaged fingers.
This PASS should not be described as pixel-perfect or as proof that every temporal transition is invisible.
limitations: The 49-frame set was sampled at 17 native frames plus the two review boards; every source frame was not individually displayed.
No continuous WebP or browser playback was performed by this reviewer. Root must independently verify playback, loop transitions, display sizes and artifact loading.
Bridge timing and exact endpoint equality were not remeasured in this V6 hand-focused review.
Only this review record was written. No animation pixels or deployment state were changed.
